disclosures.name: Choking hazards
disclosures.description: Choking and suffocation hazards for children

disclosures.name: Choking Hazard — Small Parts (US)
disclosures.title: Choking Hazard: Small Parts
disclosures.content: **WARNING: CHOKING HAZARD — Small parts.** Not for children under 3 years.
disclosures.display_requirements: Display the disclosure (Title, Content, Symbol) pre-purchase. Age warning must be legible.

disclosures.name: Choking Hazard — Balloons (US)
disclosures.title: Balloon Choking Hazard
disclosures.content: **WARNING: CHOKING HAZARD — Children under 8 years can choke or suffocate on uninflated or broken balloons.** Adult supervision required. Keep uninflated balloons from children. Discard broken balloons at once.
disclosures.display_requirements: Display the disclosure (Title, Content, Symbol) pre-purchase. Age warning must be legible.

disclosures.name: Prop 65 — Alcohol (US-CA)
disclosures.title: Prop 65 Alcohol Warning
disclosures.content: **WARNING:** Drinking distilled spirits, beer, coolers, wine and other alcoholic beverages may increase cancer risk, and, during pregnancy, can cause birth defects. For more information go to www.P65Warnings.ca.gov/alcoholic-beverages.
disclosures.display_requirements: Display the disclosure (Title, Content, Symbol) pre-purchase. "WARNING" must be uppercase and bold.
